title: Word Stress Shifts
subtitle: Noun vs Verb Stress Pairs
description: Many English words change their meaning based solely on which syllable is stressed. Nouns are usually stressed on the first syllable, verbs on the second.
tip: For the noun, punch the FIRST syllable; for the verb, push harder on the SECOND syllable — and let the unstressed syllable go soft.
